venira.avoid_when: you search for one literal (project_search) or do not know where to start (project_plan_read_batch).
venira.output_kind: hits[] {relative_path, line_number, text, score, matched}, total_files, total_hits.
venira.speed_profile: medium; reads a bounded set of files (files_hint or a shallow listing) and scores each line.
venira.use_when: you must find the right module among candidates using several keywords.

description:
Rank files by how well they match several patterns (must, weight, fuzzy score) within files_hint or a shallow listing.
Use when: you must find the right module among candidates using several keywords.
Avoid when: you search for one literal (project_search) or do not know where to start (project_plan_read_batch).
Output: hits[] {relative_path, line_number, text, score, matched}, total_files, total_hits.

files_hint.description: Workspace paths to search instead of a shallow listing (first 20 are used).

queries.description: One or more patterns. Files are scored by how many patterns they match (must patterns are required).

must.description: 1 excludes files that do not contain this pattern (default 0).

pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against each line.

weight.description: Score multiplier for hits on this pattern (default 1; higher wins).

relative_path.description: Directory to list when files_hint is omitted (default: workspace root, depth 2, first 40 files).

name: project_selective_search
title: Selective search
